source.original_text:
Take a scalar completed Itô integral of a progressive square-integrable integrand. The sum of its squared increments along a finite nondecreasing deterministic grid is integrable. Its expectation is the integrand's squared energy over the half-open span of the grid.

On a positive finite time horizon, the given filtration and finite sample measure satisfy the usual conditions used to construct the completed Itô integral.
The integrand is real and progressive with finite product-space squared energy, and the scalar Brownian driver is relative to the given filtration.
The grid satisfies 0 ≤ t₀ ≤ ⋯ ≤ tₙ ≤ T. A grid with no cells and repeated endpoints are allowed.

\mathbb E\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(I_{t_{i+1}}-I_{t_i})^2=\int_{\Omega\times[t_0,t_n)}|\eta_r(\omega)|^2\,d(\mu\otimes dt).

theorem anonymous_target.{u_1}
  {Omega : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Omega} {filtration : MeasureTheory.Filtration NNReal m}
  {mu : MeasureTheory.Measure Omega} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure mu] {T : NNReal} {B : NNReal → Omega → ℝ}
  (eta : AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration mu T)
  (hT : 0 < T)
  (hB :
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.BrownianMotion.IsBrownianMotionWithFiltration B filtration
      mu)
  (hUsual : AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration mu)
  {n : ℕ} (times : Fin (n + 1) → NNReal) (hmono : Monotone times) (hlast : times (Fin.last n) ≤ T) :
  have squares := fun omega =>
    ∑ i,
      (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralProcess.itoIntegralProcess eta hT hB hUsual
            (times i.succ) omega -
          AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralProcess.itoIntegralProcess eta hT hB hUsual
            (times i.castSucc) omega) ^
        2;
  MeasureTheory.Integrable squares mu ∧
    ∫ (omega : Omega), squares omega ∂mu =
      ∫ (z : Omega × NNReal) in Prod.snd ⁻¹' Set.Ico (times 0) (times (Fin.last n)),
        AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.processFunction eta.process z ^
          2 ∂AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ElementaryItoIntegral.processTimeMeasure mu T

blind_reconstruction.text:
Measurable Omega with finite measure mu and filtration F; scalar Brownian process B; scalar progressive L² integrand eta; its completed Ito integral I. A finite nondecreasing time list and its sum of squared integral increments.

T>0 is nonnegative real. B,eta,I:[0,infinity)×Omega→R. lambda_T is Lebesgue measure on [0,T] represented on nonnegative reals; product measure is mu⊗lambda_T. n∈N and times:{0,...,n}→[0,infinity).

Assumptions: eta is strongly progressive for F and (omega,r)↦eta(r,omega) is in L²(mu⊗lambda_T). B satisfies standard scalar Brownian finite-dimensional distributions: for every finite nonnegative time set S, (B_s)_{s∈S} has centered Gaussian law with covariance (s,t)↦min(s,t), and B has continuous paths mu-a.e. In particular B_0=0 is required almost surely, not for every sample, is strongly adapted to F, and B_t-B_s is independent of F_s for every s≤t. F is right-continuous and every subset S⊆Omega with mu(S)=0 belongs to F_t for every t≥0. The time list is nondecreasing, not necessarily strictly increasing; its final value is at most T.

Conclusion: I is the specified continuous completed Ito integral of eta against B: the canonical elementary-integral limit off its null uniform-Cauchy exceptional set, zero on that set, and constant after T. Let S(omega)=∑_{r=0}^{n-1}(I(times_{r+1},omega)-I(times_r,omega))². Then S is mu-integrable and ∫S dmu=∫_{Omega×[times_0,times_n)} eta(v,omega)² d(mu⊗lambda_T)(omega,v).

Quantifier order: For every filtered finite measure setup, eta and Brownian B satisfying assumptions, and every n and nondecreasing list with times_n≤T, the squared-increment sum is integrable and has the stated integral.

Scope: Exact second-moment sum identity for any finite monotone partition, including repeated nodes, n=0 and a starting node different from zero. Time restriction is [times_0,times_n).

Constant dependencies: No existential constants or rates.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralIncrement

/-! # Finite-grid energy of the completed Itô process -/

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralGridEnergy

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped NNReal BigOperators
open BrownianMotion ProgressiveL2 ElementaryItoIntegral ItoIntegralProcess ItoIntegralIncrement

private theorem sum_setIntegral_grid_cells
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] {nu : Measure (Omega × ℝ≥0)}
    {f : Omega × ℝ≥0 → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f nu)
    {n : ℕ} (times : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ≥0) (hmono : Monotone times) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, ∫ z in Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ico (times i.castSucc) (times i.succ), f z ∂nu) =
      ∫ z in Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ico (times 0) (times (Fin.last n)), f z ∂nu := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    have hp := ih (times ∘ Fin.castSucc) (hmono.comp (fun _ _ hij => Fin.castSucc_le_castSucc_iff.2 hij))
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.castSucc_succ] at hp
    rw [hp]
    let a := times 0
    let b := times (Fin.last n).castSucc
    let c := times (Fin.last (n + 1))
    have hab : a ≤ b := hmono (Fin.zero_le _)
    have hbc : b ≤ c := hmono (Fin.le_last _)
    change (∫ z in Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ico a b, f z ∂nu) +
      (∫ z in Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ico b c, f z ∂nu) =
        ∫ z in Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ico a c, f z ∂nu
    rw [← Ico_union_Ico_eq_Ico hab hbc, Set.preimage_union]
    symm
    apply setIntegral_union _ (measurable_snd measurableSet_Ico) hf.integrableOn hf.integrableOn
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun _ hx hy => (not_lt_of_ge hy.1) hx.2)

/-- Add the cellwise Itô energies over a deterministic grid, with its half-open
span on the probability–time side. -/
theorem itoIntegralProcess_grid_isometry
    {Omega : Type*} {m : MeasurableSpace Omega}
    {filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 m} {mu : Measure Omega} [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ≥0} {B : ℝ≥0 → Omega → ℝ}
    (eta : ProgressiveL2Integrand filtration mu T) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hB : IsBrownianMotionWithFiltration B filtration mu)
    (hUsual : SatisfiesUsualConditions filtration mu)
    {n : ℕ} (times : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ≥0)
    (hmono : Monotone times) (hlast : times (Fin.last n) ≤ T) :
    let squares := fun omega => ∑ i : Fin n,
      (itoIntegralProcess eta hT hB hUsual (times i.succ) omega -
        itoIntegralProcess eta hT hB hUsual (times i.castSucc) omega)^2
    Integrable squares mu ∧
      (∫ omega, squares omega ∂mu) =
        ∫ z in Prod.snd ⁻¹' Set.Ico (times 0) (times (Fin.last n)),
          (processFunction eta.process z)^2 ∂(processTimeMeasure mu T) := by
  intro squares
  let inc := fun (i : Fin n) omega =>
    itoIntegralProcess eta hT hB hUsual (times i.succ) omega -
      itoIntegralProcess eta hT hB hUsual (times i.castSucc) omega
  have hc (i : Fin n) :=
    itoIntegralProcess_increment_isometry eta hT hB hUsual
      (hmono (Fin.castSucc_le_succ (i := i))) ((hmono (Fin.le_last _)).trans hlast)
  have hi (i : Fin n) : Integrable (fun omega => (inc i omega)^2) mu :=
    (hc i).1.integrable_sq
  refine ⟨integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hi i), ?_⟩
  change (∫ omega, ∑ i : Fin n, (inc i omega)^2 ∂mu) = _
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ z in Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ico (times i.castSucc) (times i.succ),
          (processFunction eta.process z)^2 ∂(processTimeMeasure mu T) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (hc i).2)
    _ = _ := sum_setIntegral_grid_cells eta.memLp.integrable_sq times hmono

#print axioms itoIntegralProcess_grid_isometry

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoIntegralGridEnergy

steps.title: Apply the isometry on each cell
steps.text: The scalar increment is square integrable on each cell. Therefore its square and their finite sum are integrable.
steps.lean:
have hc (i : Fin n) :=
    itoIntegralProcess_increment_isometry eta hT hB hUsual
      (hmono (Fin.castSucc_le_succ (i := i))) ((hmono (Fin.le_last _)).trans hlast)
  have hi (i : Fin n) : Integrable (fun omega => (inc i omega)^2) mu :=
    (hc i).1.integrable_sq
  refine ⟨integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hi i), ?_⟩

steps.title: Combine the adjacent intervals
steps.text: Exchange the finite sum and integral. The cell intervals are disjoint and concatenate to the grid span. Equal adjacent endpoints contribute an empty interval.
steps.lean:
rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i)]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ z in Prod.snd ⁻¹' Ico (times i.castSucc) (times i.succ),
          (processFunction eta.process z)^2 ∂(processTimeMeasure mu T) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (hc i).2)
    _ = _ := sum_setIntegral_grid_cells eta.memLp.integrable_sq times hmono
